purpose: Find community workflows with inspectable mechanisms and counterexamples. Record public engagement only when the retrieved source displays it.

method.discovery: Read public Reddit Top lists and run targeted web queries across Reddit, X, GitHub, Substack and technical references.
method.verification: Open the primary post and inspect the named claim. Check linked source code, prompt files, public article sections or the methodology table wherever available.
method.selection: Prefer a clearly described method with a named failure mode and a way to test it. Use high engagement to decide which posts to inspect first. Keep relevant lower engagement material when it supplies implementation detail or documents a limit.
method.engagement: Copy vote counts and dates from the indexed Reddit snapshots. Copy stars from the retrieved repository pages and X views from the indexed page. The numbers are snapshots. Rank applies only to DC05 in the captured monthly Top feed. No global viral threshold or rank was inferred.
method.access: Public read-only retrieval. No site account, cookie copy, proxy purchase, paywall bypass, installation or external post. Some index and direct page captures have different cache ages. Rank and vote counts can change between captures.
